steps.text: Choose a starting player: purple 1st player pawn
From the player on their left, clockwise, pick a Player Board (each has a Family Bonus)
steps.note: Asquith: extra family member. Cavendish: reputation position 4. Ponsonby: 300 pounds. York: 2 footmen

steps.text: Reputation counter 1 on the wheel, wheel marker on position 1; other counters nearby
5 starting servants in Available Service: Butler, Housekeeper, Valet, Lady's Maid, Footman
Country Estate Organiser by your board with the 5 START Improvement Tiles, building icon up
Gentry deck: your 4 family cards plus 2 random Starter Guests
Deal 5 Objective Cards each
steps.note: Extended play: 4 cards, and add the 7/8 reputation counter

steps.text: Servants for Hire: 2 Underbutlers, {f} Footmen, {v} Valets, {v} Lady's Maids
Remaining Objective Cards and the coin bank on the supply board
Casual guests: shuffle the leftover Starter Guests with the 35 casual guests; shuffle the 25 prestige guests
Tile bag: all improvement tiles except monuments and unused START tiles, plus monuments: {s}
Round track (16-round side for standard play) with the white pawn on 1; Victory Point and Theme Cards shuffled on it
A Reminder Tile per player; Charles and Elizabeth Fairchild cards by the round track
Builders' Market: draw qualifying tiles (prestige 1-3, Brushing Room, Barn, Butler's Pantry, Servants' Quarters) to fill it, in ascending Tile Sorting Number order
You are always the starting player; choose any family board and set up your player area as usual
Round track and supply board as for 2 players, Standard Play side; closed courtship is used
Choose one of the 12 Solitaire opponent cards (beginner, intermediate or expert) and place it by your board
Solitaire AI card and the 20-sided dice near the Builders' Market
An Underbutler is only gained by buying a Butler's Pantry tile, never hired by the Butler
Reveal a Theme Card to begin the first season; the 1st player takes the first turn
